intent: Tests: two Dashboard UI tests wait for the state they read (Windows CI races)
notes: `test_workspace_tabs.py` `_keys()` now waits until the landing page has hydrated and its requests are idle. Before, a late workspace save from that page could undo a test's `sessionStorage.clear()` and leave an extra repository-less tab (`test_switch_restores_each_context` on Windows CI, run 39158653845).
`test_loop_list_active_first_sort` waits for the loop cards, which arrive from a separate `/loops` request, before reading them (Windows CI, run 39155143491; recorded on #70).
